context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly resolves an existing risk register row: Status/Date/Decision all changed together, every other column left untouched, the row never deleted or renumbered, and the schema validation script re-run to confirm the edit.

checklist.name: Status/Date/Decision changed together
checklist.description: Status becomes Resolved, Date becomes a real date, and Decision becomes a self-contained sentence, all three in the same edit

checklist.name: Other columns untouched
checklist.description: Item, Type, Description, Risk if unaddressed, and Added are never edited beyond an optional short clarifying clause

checklist.name: Row never deleted or renumbered
checklist.description: The row keeps its original # and is not deleted or reordered

checklist.name: Re-validation confirmed
checklist.description: Agent re-runs validate-risk-register-schema.sh and confirms it passes after the edit

checklist.name: Self-contained decision text
checklist.description: The Decision sentence stands alone without requiring the reader to already know the resolution
